issues.description: Field 'global_count': the problem statement (problem_statement.md) requires a 32-bit integer named `global_count` ("Definieren Sie eine Variable `global_count` als 32-Bit Integer"). The solution (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm) instead declares `global_count db 0`, which defines an 8-bit byte. This type mismatch can confuse students about the required storage size and how to declare the variable in NASM (dd vs db) and may lead to incorrect behavior if code assumes a 32-bit value.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution declaration to a 32-bit integer in the data section, e.g. `global_count dd 0`. Optionally add the same `global_count dd 0` declaration to the template repository to provide a consistent hint for students.
